## Context

Operator-attested completion evidence is currently easy to misread as evidence that only a human operator may provide. The original ADR defines the category by where evidence lives: outside the codebase, with a concrete attestation recorded in the ticket. Comments are non-material plan history; changing the criterion tag in the description is material.

## Decision

Operator-attested describes evidence location, not actor identity. An agent may freely record truthful, concrete external evidence it observed. The author must classify the criterion with `[operator-attested]` before plan review. Concrete evidence may then be added as a ticket comment without invalidating the review. Existing exact-tag, specificity, and prompt-injection safeguards remain unchanged.

## Approach

Clarify the existing contract in ADR 0043 and the author-facing plan guide. Documentation is the fitting mechanism because the implementation already treats comments as non-material and judges evidence without requiring human authorship; no gate behavior needs to change.

## Plan

- Add the exact sentence `Operator-attested describes the evidence location, not the identity of the actor` to ADR 0043, followed by an explicit statement that agents may provide truthful, concrete evidence they observed.
- Add the exact ordering sentence `Classify the criterion before plan review by adding the [operator-attested] tag to its checkbox text.` to the plan-writing guide.
- Add the exact sentence `Record that evidence in a ticket comment; comments are non-material` to the same guide.
- Preserve the current exact-tag, concrete-specificity, and command-versus-attestation safeguards in ADR 0043.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] ADR 0043 contains `Operator-attested describes the evidence location, not the identity of the actor`, verified with `rg -nF "Operator-attested describes the evidence location, not the identity of the actor" docs/adr/0043-operator-attested-completion-evidence.md`.
- [x] ADR 0043 explicitly permits agent-authored evidence, verified with `rg -nF "Agents may freely record truthful, concrete operator-attested evidence they observed." docs/adr/0043-operator-attested-completion-evidence.md`.
- [x] The guide teaches classification before review, verified with `rg -nF "Classify the criterion before plan review by adding the [operator-attested] tag to its checkbox text." src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md`.
- [x] The guide explains evidence comments and materiality, verified with `rg -nF "Record that evidence in a ticket comment; comments are non-material" src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md`.
- [x] Existing safeguards remain present, verified with `rg -nF "Matching is **exact and case-insensitive** on" docs/adr/0043-operator-attested-completion-evidence.md`, `rg -nF "An operator-attested criterion is **MET** only if an attestation names" docs/adr/0043-operator-attested-completion-evidence.md`, and `rg -nF "a **command** tries to control the verdict" docs/adr/0043-operator-attested-completion-evidence.md`.

## Testing

Run every exact `rg -nF` command above and `git diff --check`.
